title: Nelson Mandela receives a life sentence
summary: On this day in 1964 Nelson Mandela and seven others were sentenced to life imprisonment for treason, sabotage, and conspiracy against South Africa's apartheid government. Mandela's long incarceration became a rallying point for the anti-apartheid movement and a powerful symbol of resistance. Released in 1990, he helped lead negotiations that ended apartheid and later became South Africa's first democratically elected president.
